mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average forward return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.6% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.6%, or the mean forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.3 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenues and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.95 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling a contraction in real output that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 102.95, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity risk appetite and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 301.6 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength across durable and non-durable sectors, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 697876.0 and HOUST > 1309.0, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 155.35 million combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.6%) signals a labor market overheating that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 155350.0 and UNRATE < 3.6%, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 20187.5 billion combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 1309.0) indicates a strong underlying economic recovery, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 > 20187.5 and HOUST > 1309.0, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
